description: Count sentences, see average words per sentence, and find your longest sentence.

faqs.a: Text is split on . ! ? followed by a space or end of text; common abbreviations like Mr. and Dr. are handled.
The longest sentence is shown in full with its word count.

faqs.q: What counts as a word here?
faqs.a: Sequences of letters and digits; hyphenated compounds count as a single word.

howto: Check sentence count, average length and the longest sentence.
title: Sentence Counter
